A ball is thrown upward from the ground with height
\[
s(t)=20t-4.9t^2
\]
where $s$ is measured in meters and $t$ in seconds.
Find:
\begin{enumerate}
\item the velocity at time $t$,
\item the velocity after $2$ seconds,
\item the maximum height reached by the ball.
\end{enumerate}

v(t)=s'(t)=20 - \frac{49 t}{5}.

20-\frac{49}{5}t=0 \Rightarrow t=\frac{100}{49}.
s\!\left(\frac{100}{49}\right)=\frac{1000}{49} \approx 20.4082.
\]
